def main():
    n = int(input())
    arr = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        arr[i] = int(input())
    arr.sort()
    itv = int(input())
    ans = 0
    for i in range(n):
        limit = itv + arr[i]
        temp = 0
        for j in range(i, n):
            if arr[j] <= limit:
                temp += 1
        if temp > ans:
            ans = temp
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
